Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
chore: merge upstream astro-paper v5.5.1

Updates from v5.2.0 to v5.5.1:
- v5.5.1: Tag component improvements, OG image fixes
- v5.5.0: Enhanced file name transformer
- v5.4.x: RTL support, Shiki transformers, code block improvements
- v5.3.0: Improved back-to-top button, scroll anchor fixes

Preserved custom config:
- Site settings \(title, author, language\)
- Social links \(GitHub, Mail\)
EOF
\)")

EOF
\)")
